headline: Approved amending the 2026-2027 budget to create an Information Technology Administrator position, 7-1.
summary: Members met in executive session to discuss a pending legal claim, then unanimously approved a memorandum of agreement with Brian Dolan. Chief of staff Peterson gave an overview of the budget item and answered questions before the vote. Vice Chair Alston shared dates for upcoming Civil Service Commission, Board of Ethics and Retirement Board meetings.
decisions: Approved a memorandum of agreement with Brian Dolan, settling a pending legal claim, by unanimous vote.
Approved amending the 2026-2027 budget and establishing the position of Information Technology Administrator, 7-1.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
ADMINISTRATION & SETTLEMENT 
COMMITTEE MINUTES DRAFT 
 
Committee Chair: 
Absent - Rhonda Caldwell 
Committee Vice Chair: 
Present - Jeron Alston 
Committee Members: 
Present - Tameeka Parks 
Present - Tasha Hunt 
Present - Doug Foley 
Present - Abdul Osmanu 
Present - Adrian Webber 
Ex-Officio Voting: 
Present - Sarah Gallagher, Maj. Leader 
Present - Bob Anthony, Min. Leader 
Ex-Officio Non-Voting: 
Absent - Katie Kiely, President  
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Administration and Settlement Committee, September 28, 2026 – 7pm.  The meeting was 
called to order by Vice Chair Alston at 8:16pm with the members noted above in 
attendance.  
  
 
 
 
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
The Public Input Session was opened at approximately 8:17pm.  No one came forward to 
give public comment and the Input Session was closed at 8:18pm. 
  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Vice Chair Alston shared upcoming meeting dates for the Civil Service Commission, 
Board of Ethics and Retirement Board.  He also mentioned that the Munis Year-to-Date 
reports for the departments listed below were included in the back-up for anyone 
interested. 
  
 
Board of Ethics Update 
  
 
Human Resources/Civil Service Update  
  
 
Legislative Council Update  
  
 
Town Government Center Update 
  
 
Probate Court Update 
  
 
Town Attorney Update 
 
  
Vice Chair Alston asked for a motion to reorder the agenda, moving the Executive Session 
ahead of the regular agenda. The motion was made by Minority Leader Anthony and seconded 
by Vice Chair Alston.  
Vote: All in favor. 
 
Vice Chair Alston then called for a motion to go into Executive Session noting that along with 
committee members, Attorney Sue Gruen and Nick Grello would be joining.  The motion was 
made by Council member Foley and seconded by Council member Hunt.   
Vote: All in favor.
At the conclusion of the Executive Session, Vice Chair Alston took the roll and the following 
committee members were present – Alston, Anthony, Foley, Gallagher, Hunt, Osmanu Parks, 
Webber.   
 
Vice Chair Alston called for a motion to adjust the agenda and add the order approving the 
settlement agreement.  The motion was made by council member Foley and seconded by 
Minority Leader Anthony.   
 
Vice Chair Alston reiterated the reason for the executive session was to discuss a pending 
legal claim and noted that with the item now on the agenda, they could move forward to vote on 
the settlement. 
 
ORDER APPROVING A MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE TOWN OF 
HAMDEN AND BRIAN DOLAN 
Motion to approve the settlement was made by Minority Leader Anthony and seconded by 
Majority Leader Gallagher. 
Vote: All in favor.  Item passed unanimously. 
 
Vice Chair Alston went back to the regular agenda.  
4. REGULAR COMMITTEE AGENDA  
  1. ORDER AMENDING THE 2026-2027 BUDGET AND ESTABLISHING THE 
POSITION OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY ADMINISTRATOR 
Motion to open item 4.1 was made by Council member Foley and seconded by 
Council member Parks. 
Chief of staff Peterson gave an overview of the item and answered a few questions 
from the council members. 
Vote: 7 in favor, 1 opposed (Anthony), 0 abstentions.  Item passed.  
5. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
See details above 
  
6. NEW COMMITTEE BUSINESS 
There was no new business for this evening’s meeting. 
 
ADJOURN 
With no additional business before the committee, Vice Chair Alston called for a motion to 
adjourn.  The motion was made by Council member Parks and seconded by Vice Chair 
Alston.  All were in favor.  The meeting was adjourned at 9:11pm.
